mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venues (id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, master_venue_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{address}, #{city}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, #{source}, #{masterVenueId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, master_venue_id, created_at, updated_at FROM venues WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE venues SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, city = #{city}, location_lat = #{locationLat}, location_lng = #{locationLng}, metadata = #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, confidence = #{confidence}, source = #{source}, master_venue_id = #{masterVenueId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: AND (LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(city) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, master_venue_id, created_at, updated_at FROM venues
ORDER BY
name DESC name ASC created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE venues SET embedding = #{embedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.PgVectorTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM venues WHERE embedding IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
